description:
Peggle Nights expands the pachinko-inspired formula with a nocturnal theme, introducing new challenges that take
place within the dreamscapes of the Peggle Masters. Featuring a new Master, Marina, and her electricity-based
power-up, the game offers additional levels and trials that demand refined skill and tactical shot-planning.

peggle-nights-v1.0.0.description: _Peggle Nights - Another pachinko-inspired arcade game by PopCap Games_ **Randomizer Features** * All 70 Quick Play levels + 11 Peggle Masters supported * Ability to select individual levels to include / exclude from generation * Ability to select individual masters to include / exclude from generation * Ability to customize how many levels to play (5-70) * Ability to customize how many masters are available for play (1-11) * Ability to set / randomize difficulty of target scores. By level or globally * Ability to convert filler items into useful items during generation to provide additional help * Starting Ball Count / Fever Meter logic * Scales well for all types of multiworlds: Short / Long Syncs, Asyncs; ~50-950 checks * Custom client UI that displays important information and updates in real-time (see screenshot) * No modding! Only light memory manipulation that works directly from the client * Universal Tracker (UT) fully supported (and recommended for guidance). YAML-free! **How it works and what to expect** - A custom campaign of N levels is generated based on your settings - You are granted a starting level and master where you are able to complete your first location checks - You start with only 5 balls, but can receive more - Your fever meter is capped at each multiplier, but you can receive upgrades - You progress through the campaign by receiving level unlocks and progressive items - You will also gather some shadow pegs along the way. These are needed for both goal types. Either: - Collect N shadow pegs to unlock a final level and clear it to win - Collect N shadow pegs to win - Each master's power is usable right away - Your playthrough will have you jumping between levels as you unlock more stuff, not just beating levels and moving on - The game is one the shorter side, with high check density. It is on the easier side, save for high tier scores and full clears - Since the game hasn't been deeply modified, you won't be prevented from playing anything. That said, locations checks will only be registered when meeting the proper requirements **Locations** - Fever Meter Multipliers (2X, 3X, 5X, 10X) - Level Clears - Target Scores (Low / Mid / High) - Style Shots - Orange Peg Combos (3X, 5X) - Peg Combos (7X, 15X) - Full Clears (optional) **Items** - Level Unlocks - Master Unlocks - Progressive Fever Meter Thresholds (Locks Fever Meter Multiplier, Level Clear and Target Score locations) - Progressive Starting Ball Increases (Locks Target Score and Full Clear locations) - Shadow Pegs (Macguffins) - Level-specific useful items to progressively make things (even) easier: Fever Meter Permanent Bonuses, Full Clear Discounts, Score Multipliers, Target Score Discounts
peggle-nights-v1.0.0.title: Peggle Nights - 1.0.0

peggle-nights-v1.0.1r2.description:
This is a minor bugfix / improvement release. 

**This release IS compatible with games generated on 1.0.x versions**

**Improvement:** Any errors are now saved in `peggle_nights_errors.log` in your Archipelago directory instead of output to the client
**Improvement:** Entering Fever Mode now multiplies the multiplier by 10, regardless of your current fever meter cap (e.g. entering fever mode with 2 Progressive Fever Meter Threshold items will give you a 50x multiplier for the duration of fever mode). This is a buff.

**Fix:** Addressed an issue where Warren would be able to send Level Clear location checks while the Triple Score buff was active
**Fix:** Addressed an issue where the goal level would light up in the custom client tab without having 4 Progressive Fever Meter Threshold items (i.e. only having the level unlock + required gold pegs)
**Fix:** Addressed an issue where Fever Meter Multiplier location checks would send when hitting pegs in Fever Mode without their required amount of Progressive Fever Meter Threshold items 

**Link to the original release, with README:** [Here](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/releases/tag/peggle-nights-v1.0.0)
peggle-nights-v1.0.1r2.title: Peggle Nights - 1.0.1

peggle-nights-v1.0.2.description:
This is a minor bugfix / improvement release that is likely to be the _final release_ for this game. I do not intend to work on it further.

**This release is NOT compatible with games generated on prior versions since item / location names have been altered**

**Fix:** Removed square bracket notation in item / location names referring to levels. While square brackets are not disallowed for these names, a handful of other Archipelago implementations do not handle them correctly, all the way to fully crashing / not working at all. Let's aim for maximum compatibility even if Peggle isn't in the wrong here.

**WARNING: This change will INVALIDATE any existing YAML as the `level_selection` option used to contain those square brackets. You can either remove the square brackets manually or copy / paste the option from the new template YAML and set the values according to your preferences**

**Tweak:** `Target Score (High)` can now be sent out-of-logic (i.e. without having 4 Progressive Fever Meter items)

**Link to the previous release:** [Here](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/releases/tag/peggle-nights-v1.0.1)
**Link to the original release, with README:** [Here](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/releases/tag/peggle-nights-v1.0.0)

peggle-nights-v1.1.0.description:
This is a minor release. All logic rules have been rewritten using Archipelago's 0.6.7 new Rule Builder system. A few small benefits:

- Support for Universal Tracker's `explain` and `get_logical_path` commands
- Marginally faster / safer generation

Expected to be compatible with ongoing games (since only generation has been modified)
peggle-nights-v1.1.0.title: Peggle Nights - 1.1.0

peggle-nights-v1.2.0.description: This is a feature release that also includes improvements and fixes. **This release SHOULD compatible with games generated on the previous version. It won't break anything if some parts are not.** - **Feature:** The Universal Tracker tab and features will now be embedded in the Peggle Nights Client (provided you have the latest Universal Tracker APWorld installed) - **Feature:** Added a section near the top of the custom client tab that outlines what items are needed for major location groups to enter logic, as well as how many of each of those items you currently have - **Improvement:** Edited all level images to include World-Level shorthand (e.g. 3-2) - **Improvement:** Added actual target scores to Universal Tracker location labels - **Improvement:** Universal Tracker will now show locations that might be possible to get out of logic - **Fix:** Optimized current level and master image loading in custom client tab - **Fix:** Added an extra linebreak at the end of the spoiler header

peggle-nights-v2.0.0.description:
This is a major feature release that also includes improvements and tweaks. 
It brings Peggle Nights to parity with the features of Peggle Deluxe 2.2.0.

**This release is NOT compatible with games generated on the previous version.**

- **Feature:** In-Game Level Locking
- **Feature:** In-Game Master Locking
- **Feature:** Progressive Fever Meter Threshold items have been completely replaced by level-specific Progressive Orange Pegs items, leading to more interesting and layered progression, as well as requiring a bit more skill for the early game phase
- **Feature:** Purple Pegs are now unlockable by level
- **Feature:** Each Peggle Master now has their own set of Progressive Green Pegs items, creating opportunities for suboptimal masters to now be optimal to play under certain circumstances
- **Feature:** Added in / out of logic location counts under each level image in the Levels section of the custom client tab. Requires Universal Tracker to be installed
- **Feature:** The section of the custom client tab showing information about the current level now lists what locations are accessible in / out of logic. Requires Universal Tracker to be installed
- **Improvement:** To avoid the confusion that was present in 1.x.x around getting fever mode and no completion check, Level Clear location checks will now unlock after any fever mode completes. They will require half your starting ball items logically, but nothing prevents them from triggering
- **Improvement:** To preserve the relevance of the 4th Progressive Orange Pegs item now that level completions have moved to the early-mid game, new Fever Meter Full location checks have been added
- **Improvement:** Starting level count increased from 1 to 3
- **Improvement:** Starting ball count is now set through a custom code patch instead of directly setting the memory value, meaning that the Ball-O-Tron will now always display the correct amount of balls
- **Improvement:** Getting the required quantity of Shadow Pegs is now all that's needed to access and clear the final level. No extra items to chase
- **Improvement:** Added 3 extra copies of Progressive Starting Ball Increase and 1 extra copy of each Progressive Orange Pegs variant to allow for less restrictive progression and reaching the cap faster
- **Improvement:** Slightly reworked logic, mainly around fever meter multipliers
- **Improvement:** Custom client tab has been updated to reflect the new features
- **Tweak:** Permanent Fever Meter Bonus useful items have been removed

_No new YAML options. Minimum level count is now 15 to make room for all the new items. You will need to remove Permanent Fever Meter Bonus from your useful item weights for existing YAMLs to be valid_

The implementation now has proper [documentation](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/blob/peggle-nights/worlds/peggle_nights/docs/en_Peggle_Nights.md) and a [setup guide](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/blob/peggle-nights/worlds/peggle_nights/docs/setup_en.md)
peggle-nights-v2.0.0.title: Peggle Nights - 2.0.0
